Let me help you fix that image path. Instead of:
```html
<img 
  src="./blog/images/index-mooney-frog.png"
  ...
/>
```

You should use:
```html
<img 
  src="/images/index-mooney-frog.png"
  ...
/>
```

The reason is that Astro's `public` directory is served at the root of your site, so any files in `public/images` are accessible at `/images` in your final site.
